tests.description: Descriptive measures, hypotheses, uncertainty and statistical decisions.

questions.prompt: A report must distinguish observed summaries from population claims. Which statements support a defensible K13 explanation?

options.text: The mean is unaffected by extreme observations.
options.why: Large extremes can change it substantially.

options.text: Descriptive statistics summarise observations while inference reasons beyond a sample under assumptions.
options.why: Their purposes are related but distinct.

options.text: An association or regression coefficient alone establishes causation.
options.why: Further causal reasoning is required.

options.text: Standard deviation always has squared measurement units.
options.why: Variance has squared units; standard deviation does not.

options.text: A mode is a most frequent value or category and need not be unique.
options.why: More than one mode can occur.

options.text: A low p-value is the probability that the null hypothesis is true.
options.why: That is not the conditional definition.

options.text: Any statistically significant result must be operationally important.
options.why: Practical importance needs separate assessment.

options.text: The mean can be sensitive to extremes; the median is an ordered central value.
options.why: Choice of summary should reflect the distribution.

questions.answer: Descriptive statistics summarise observations while inference reasons beyond a sample under assumptions. The mean can be sensitive to extremes; the median is an ordered central value. A mode is a most frequent value or category and need not be unique.

source.excerpt: Descriptive statistics summarise observed data; inferential statistics use a sample and assumptions to reason about a wider process or population.

questions.prompt: Synthetic durations are [2, 4, 4, 6, 9] days. Which descriptive-statistics statements are correct?

options.text: The mean duration is 5 days.
options.why: The sum is 25 days across five observations.

options.text: The value 9 must be removed before calculating any summary.
options.why: An unusual observation needs investigation, not automatic deletion.

options.text: The mode is 4 days.
options.why: Four occurs more frequently than the other values.

options.text: The median duration is 4 days.
options.why: The third ordered observation is four.

options.text: The mode is 9 days because it is the largest value.
options.why: Mode depends on frequency, not magnitude.

options.text: Standard deviation must be reported in squared days.
options.why: Standard deviation uses the original units.

options.text: Changing only 9 to 90 would alter the mean but leave the median at 4.
options.why: An extreme value changes the sum without changing the middle ordered value.

options.text: The median duration is 5 days because the mean is 5.
options.why: The ordered middle value, not the mean, defines the median.

questions.answer: The mean duration is 5 days. The median duration is 4 days. The mode is 4 days. Changing only 9 to 90 would alter the mean but leave the median at 4.
